title: Transfer Method of Ambrosia Beetle Sterilization
author: M. Elizabeth Moore
materials: Sterilize surfaces of BSC with 70% Ethanol
Place all materials, including beetles (should be held in a collecting flask with the opening covered), into the BSC
Flame sterilize fine forceps using the lighter
Parafilm petri dish and return to growth chamber
Always alternating wet and dry dishes

steps.title: Prepare Biosafety Cabinet
steps.instruction: Turn on the BSC for at least 4 minutes.

steps.title: Label Petri Dishes
steps.instruction: Label each petri dish with the beetle information, transfer number, and next transfer details.

substeps.instruction: Include species, source, date collected, and approximate number of beetles.
Assign transfer numbers (e.g., first dish is T0, second is T1).
Specify details of the next transfer (wet or dry, time of day).

steps.title: Prepare Filter Paper
steps.instruction: Place sterile filter paper into each sterile petri dish using sterilized fine forceps.

steps.title: Prepare Wet Transfers
steps.instruction: For wet transfers, add 1000uL of autoclaved DI water to the filter paper in each petri dish; omit this for dry transfers.

steps.title: Transfer Beetles to Dishes
steps.instruction: Add beetles to the petri dishes, maintaining a density of 100 beetles or less per standard size petri dish to prevent leg damage.

substeps.instruction: Dump beetles directly from the flask into the petri dish.
Use flat forceps to move any stragglers.

steps.title: Execute Transfer Sequence
steps.instruction: Alternate beetles between wet and dry petri dishes, starting and ending with a wet dish to prevent desiccation.

substeps.instruction: Perform the standard sequence of 3 transfers (wet -- dry -- wet), or add more steps if needed.
Example: Day 1 afternoon (wet) -> Day 2 morning (dry) -> Day 2 afternoon (wet).

steps.title: Post-Transfer Holding
steps.instruction: Hold beetles in a wet petri dish after the final transfer before establishing them on wood or artificial media.

substeps.instruction: Beetles can be held for up to a week, though transferring to substrate within 3-4 days is recommended.
Follow the Ambrosia Beetle Surface Sterilization Protocol (https://dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x54v9bk44l3e/v1) immediately before setting up on wood or media.
